rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis studies a completely different alloy system (WTaTiVZr) and compares it to pure tungsten, whereas the hidden target adds Cr to HfMoTaTiZr and compares it to the baseline HfMoTaTiZr. This is a different kind of intervention.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis uses room-temperature compression, indentation plastometry up to 500 °C, and scratch testing, while the hidden target uses room-temperature compression only. The temperature regimes and testing methods are different.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes solid-solution strengthening and plasticity mechanisms based on elemental roles in a two-phase BCC microstructure, while the hidden target relies on solid-solution hardening plus crack hindrance from a reticulated Laves phase. The mechanisms are different in class and structural mediator.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts higher strength and plasticity relative to pure tungsten, while the hidden target predicts concurrent increases in yield strength and fracture strain relative to HfMoTaTiZr. The property directions are similar in general terms, but the baselines and specific outcomes differ.
